proof_body:
by
  intro K L M _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂
  obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := LieAlgebra.hasCentralRadical_and_of_isIrreducible_of_isFaithful K L M
  refine ⟨h3.radical_eq_center, fun x => (h4 x).trans ?_⟩
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨c, hc⟩ => ⟨c, hc.symm⟩, fun ⟨c, hc⟩ => ⟨c, hc.symm⟩⟩
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) (L : Type*) (M : Type*) [Field K] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra K L] [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [LieRingModule L M] [LieModule K L M] [FiniteDimensional K L] [FiniteDimensional K M] [CharZero K] [IsAlgClosed K], LieModule.IsIrreducible K L M → LieModule.IsFaithful K L M → LieAlgebra.radical K L = LieAlgebra.center K L ∧ ∀ x : L, x ∈ LieAlgebra.center K L ↔ ∃ c : K, LieModule.toEnd K L M x = c • LinearMap.id
